name: twincat-automation
description: TwinCAT 3 IDE automation and PLC runtime control

tools.name: ConnectIde
tools.description: Connect to TwinCAT 3 IDE (XAE Shell or VS2022)

tools.name: NewProject
tools.description: Create new TwinCAT project with PLC and MAIN program. #70: only on an IDE with no solution open (otherwise SOLUTION_ALREADY_OPEN, nothing created); not offered on the MCP server

tools.name: OpenProject
tools.description: Open existing TwinCAT solution

tools.name: GetProjectTree
tools.description: Read full project structure as JSON tree

tools.name: AddPou
tools.description: Add a Structured Text POU (Program, FunctionBlock or Function) and read it back (data.path, objectKind, itemType, language, declaration); an existing name -> POU_CREATE_FAILED

tools.name: WritePouCode
tools.description: Write Structured Text code into a POU, DUT or GVL (DUT / GVL: Declaration only, Implementation -> INVALID_PARAMS)

tools.name: BuildProject
tools.description: Build PLC project and return results (data.buildSucceeded, data.codeErrors from the XAE Error List)

tools.name: CleanProject
tools.description: Clean the solution (Build > Clean) and wait until SolutionBuild.BuildState is Done; CLEAN_TIMEOUT / CLEAN_FAILED; LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED when only unresolved libraries failed (a later Build success may be false, #45; AllowUnresolvedLibrary accepts it with data.warningCode); CLEAN_UNVERIFIED when LastBuildInfo is unreadable; data.cleanVerified

AllowUnresolvedLibrary.description: Accept a clean whose only errors are unresolved libraries (success + data.warningCode LIBRARY_UNRESOLVED, cleanVerified=false)

tools.name: GetBuildErrors
tools.description: Read the compiler messages shown in the XAE Error List window (UI Automation): counts plus errors[] with code/description/file/line

TimeoutSec.description: Hard limit for the UI Automation scan (5-600)

tools.name: EnableConfig
tools.description: Activate TwinCAT configuration. Use Force to do full Config->Activate->Run cycle via ADS (no dialogs)

tools.name: EnterPlcOnline
tools.description: Login to PLC runtime and download program (no dialogs: prompts handled by the global SilentMode; -LoginMode Regular|Download|OnlineChange = 1/4/2, SILENT flag only with -SilentFlag)

PlcProjectPath.description: Tree path to PLC project (auto-detected if omitted)

tools.name: SetSystemState
tools.description: Switch TwinCAT system state via ADS WriteControl (no dialogs)

tools.name: ClearLifecycleBlock
tools.description: Remove the LIFECYCLE_BLOCKED record of one target (#68). Call ONLY after the user saw data.lifecycleBlock and agreed; never to get past LIFECYCLE_BLOCKED on your own

Reason.description: The user's approval in their words

FallbackMethod.description: How the work continues after the block is lifted, as the user approved it (#113)

AllowedSideEffects.description: Side effects the user allowed, one entry each; exactly ["none"] when none, never none with another entry (#113)

MaxVerifyLevel.description: The highest layer the verification after this clear will reach; results must not claim more than it (#113). A missing, empty or invalid field returns LIFECYCLE_RECEIPT_INCOMPLETE

AmsNetId.description: Default: IDE target, then ADS session

tools.name: ReportIssue
tools.description: Build a de-identified, pre-filled GitHub new-issue URL (data.url) plus the same title/body as text (data.body, complete) for a problem found while using this tool (#78). Creates nothing, no GitHub or network call, no IDE/ADS access, works while LIFECYCLE_BLOCKED. Masks user names in paths, machine names, AMS NetIds, IP/MAC, e-mail, project paths (to file name), secrets (data.masks); ExtraMask hides customer/site names. URL capped at MaxUrlLength (data.truncated, [truncated]). Show data.maskReport and data.body to the user; ONLY the user opens and submits the URL (the repository is public).

Tool.description: Tool or cmdlet that was called

Parameters.description: Parameters of that call (object or JSON string)

Result.description: The failing {success,error,data} result (object or JSON string); error.hint is dropped

Notes.description: Steps before the call, TwinCAT/XAE version, target kind

ExtraMask.description: Literal strings (customer/site names) to replace with <redacted>

IncludeSolutionName.description: Put the solution file name into the Environment section (default: left out)

tools.name: ConnectAds
tools.description: Connect to PLC runtime via ADS. AmsNetId is auto-detected from IDE target if omitted.

tools.name: ReadVariable
tools.description: Read PLC variable value by symbol name

tools.name: WriteVariable
tools.description: Write value to PLC variable

tools.name: GetPlcState
tools.description: Read current PLC runtime state

tools.name: SetPlcState
tools.description: Set PLC runtime state (Run/Stop/Reset) via ADS

tools.name: RunTestCycle
tools.description: Full Build-Activate-Login-Run-Test-Stop cycle

tools.name: ListOperations
tools.description: List all available operations
